summary: Separated business rules, schemas, form conversion, migration and browser storage from the UI; completed guarded CRUD for people, money, inventory, assets, daily logs, reminders and budgets.

Replaced localStorage autosave with validated IndexedDB transactions, post-commit acknowledgement, workspace identity/revision conflicts, retained drafts, reviewed replacements and recovery snapshots.

Added exact settlement history and cash/receivable/payable calculations, integer-scaled stock movements, reference and history guards, calendar recurrence, daily closing history, literal pagination and formula-safe exports.

Added reviewed legacy migration with explicit partial-payment reconciliation and preserved source text, nine detailed learning chapters, meaningful domain/storage/browser verification, reproducible setup and historical notices on the earlier curriculum.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0, Next 16.2.6, React 19.2.4, TypeScript 5.9.3, Zod 3.25.76, native IndexedDB; fake-indexeddb 6.2.4 for deterministic storage tests; Chromium 148 disposable profiles
checks.command: npm test; npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm run build; python scripts/verify_browser.py

limits: Single-browser local workspace with no authenticated account, shared backend, cross-device synchronization, bank connection or public deployment certification. Browser data can be cleared or evicted; separate exported backups are necessary.

Validated JSON aggregate in IndexedDB: 8 MiB workspace, 2000 records per ordinary collection, 10000 activity events, 30 checklist labels and 20 recovery snapshots. Capacity rejects writes without silent history truncation. Whole-workspace revision conflicts can include unrelated edits.

Supports USD, PHP, EUR and GBP with two currency decimal places and three quantity decimal places. Cash has a zero initial baseline and includes migrated opening settlements with unknown historical dates. Inventory value uses current unit cost, capped at 1000000000000 cents; not cost-layer or statutory accounting.
No payment reversal, tax, bank reconciliation, full general ledger, lot tracking or normalized indexed backend. Current activity actor is a local label, not authenticated identity.

Migration accepts supported schema2 and validated schema3; unsupported shapes, broken references and excess precision are rejected. Missing partial amounts require reconciliation; prior payment dates and recurrence ancestry cannot be inferred. Malformed persisted data is preserved for export and review, without an automatic reset.

Draft exports support manual review rather than automatic restoration. Browser and injected storage checks do not establish all-browser compatibility, complete accessibility compliance, hardware power-loss survival or production scale.
